entries.24a83b75a1640469: A master plate used to transfer circuit patterns onto wafers in the exposure process of semiconductor manufacturing. The company contracts production of binary masks with simple light-shielding film patterns, phase-shift masks that control the phase of light to improve transfer characteristics, and EUV masks using extreme ultraviolet (EUV) light, according to customers' required specifications. Revenue by category is not separately disclosed.
entries.64873441f38175fd: A manufacturer that produces to order, for semiconductor makers around the world, "photomasks," the circuit master plates used in semiconductor manufacturing.
entries.a17d7128dfeb975a: This is a new business area applying microfabrication technology. The company develops and manufactures molds for nanoimprinting, which transfer nanometer-scale patterns by pressing the mold against resin, and silicon stencil masks for electron beam lithography. Revenue is not separately disclosed.
entries.fbfbf9ec169a1278: This is the only reportable segment of the company group, manufacturing and selling photomasks for semiconductors. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥129,576 million, accounting for all of consolidated revenue. The company has 8 manufacturing sites in total (5 in Asia, 1 in the United States and 2 in Europe) and, based on circuit pattern data supplied by customers, manufactures on a fully made-to-order basis and, after measurement and inspection, delivers products with guaranteed quality.
